title: Hierarchy example panics after a second or two

labels.name: D-Trivial
labels.description: Nice and easy! A great choice to get started with Bevy

labels.name: P-Regression
labels.description: Functionality that used to work but no longer does. Add a test for this!

labels.name: S-Needs-Investigation
labels.description: This issue requires detective work to figure out what's going wrong

body:
## Bevy version


Latest bevy main (post-new-renderer) (ffecb05a0ab423b46ab991b49c54516bcaf2ea7b)
Latest bevy main pre-new-renderer (de8edd3165c379e05aabb38359b3f4b97f46540a)
Also this random commit (94db0176fecfac7e7e9763f2dc7458a54c105886)

## Operating system & version

m1 mac (macos 12)

## What you did

```cargo run --example hierarchy``` or
```cargo run --example hierarchy --release```

## What actually happened

The example runs for two seconds and then panics
